title: What If You Could See 10 Seconds Into the Future?

shots.line: You step back from the curb.
shots.scene: Medium side: HERO (blue hoodie) at the curb edge next to MIA on her phone; a cyan ghost bike streaks through his spot; he calmly steps back

shots.line: One second later,
shots.scene: Insert, low: HERO's sneakers step back from the curb edge; a real front wheel enters frame

shots.line: a bike flies past,
shots.scene: Wide side: grey CYCLIST whips past along the curb between camera and HERO, speed lines

shots.line: exactly where you were standing.
shots.scene: FREEZE: bike frozen mid-pass over a dotted outline of where HERO was standing; label 'YOU WERE HERE'

shots.line: The rider shouts sorry.
shots.scene: Medium: CYCLIST rides away looking back over his shoulder, one hand raised, shout rings

shots.line: Your best friend, Mia, stares at you.
shots.scene: Two-shot: MIA (coral jacket, ponytail) lowers her phone and stares at HERO, shocked; name label MIA

shots.line: "How did you know?"
shots.scene: bigFace MIA: 'How did you know?' (talk synced), surprised

shots.line: You didn't hear it.
shots.scene: Close-up HERO profile, ear icon with a slash: no sound

shots.line: You didn't see it coming.
shots.scene: OTS from behind HERO: the bike came from behind him; eye icon with a slash

shots.line: You saw it ten seconds ago.
shots.scene: bigFace HERO: eyes turn to cyan rings, the ghost bike reflected; HUD 'T-10' appears

shots.line: What if you could see ten seconds into the future?
shots.scene: TITLE over a dusk street with a cyan double-exposure copy drifting ahead: WHAT IF YOU COULD SEE / 10 SECONDS INTO THE FUTURE?

shots.line: It starts on a Tuesday.
shots.scene: Establishing: morning kitchen, HERO at the table with cereal, calendar shows TUESDAY

shots.line: You blink,
shots.scene: Extreme close-up on HERO's eyes: a slow blink, cyan flicker

shots.line: and for a moment there are two worlds on top of each other.
shots.scene: The kitchen doubles: a cyan translucent copy slides ahead of the real one; HERO looks around, confused

shots.line: The real one...
shots.scene: Split screen begins: only the warm REAL kitchen, label REAL

shots.line: and a faint blue copy, running ten seconds ahead.
shots.scene: Split screen: the cyan copy wipes in on the right, label +10 s; HUD pill 'BLUE WORLD +10 s'

shots.line: In the blue world, your phone slides off the table.
shots.scene: Medium on the table: the cyan ghost phone slides off the edge and falls; the real phone sits still; HERO's eyes follow

shots.line: In the real world, it hasn't moved yet.
shots.scene: Insert: real phone resting at the table edge, its cyan ghost already on the floor; countdown HUD

shots.line: You wait.
shots.scene: bigFace HERO, calm, eyes on the phone

shots.line: Seven. Eight. Nine.
shots.scene: Insert push-in on the phone; big numbers 7, 8, 9 pop on the words

shots.line: It slides.
shots.scene: The real phone slides off the edge, matching the ghost

shots.line: You catch it without looking.
shots.scene: Medium: HERO catches the phone one-handed while looking away, sipping coffee; smirk

shots.line: The rules are simple.
shots.scene: Blueprint card: THE RULES

shots.line: You only see what your own eyes are going to see.
shots.scene: Blueprint rule 1: line-figure with a cyan eye cone, only what's inside the cone glows. ONLY YOUR EYES

shots.line: Never more than ten seconds ahead.
shots.scene: Blueprint rule 2: timeline NOW to +10 s window, beyond it crossed out. MAX +10 s

shots.line: And it never switches off.
shots.scene: Blueprint rule 3: a switch flicked OFF snaps back ON. ALWAYS ON

shots.line: At first, it's the best thing that has ever happened to you.
shots.scene: Golden street: HERO walks confidently, grinning, his cyan ghost walking a few steps ahead

shots.line: You never step in a puddle again.
shots.scene: Puddle: his ghost foot splashes in cyan; the real HERO steps over the puddle

shots.line: You never walk into a glass door.
shots.scene: Glass door: the cyan ghost HERO bonks into the glass; the real HERO stops and pulls the handle

shots.line: Rock, paper, scissors?
shots.scene: Insert: two fists shake rock-paper-scissors; cyan ghost shows the opponent's scissors early; HERO throws rock

shots.line: You've won four hundred games in a row.
shots.scene: Montage: opponents lose one after another; big gold counter rolls to 400 WINS IN A ROW

shots.line: Nobody plays with you anymore.
shots.scene: HERO alone holding out a fist; classmates walk away

shots.line: In class, you know the answer before the teacher finishes the question,
shots.scene: Classroom: teacher at the chalkboard '7 x 8 = ?'; HERO's hand shoots up before she finishes

shots.line: because you already heard it...
shots.scene: Close-up HERO with a cyan ghost speech bubble '56' near his ear

shots.line: from the kid who's about to get it wrong.
shots.scene: A kid raises his hand '54?'; a cyan cross flickers over him; HERO smirks

shots.line: And then there are penalty kicks.
shots.scene: 3D: night stadium under floodlights, slow orbit to the goal and penalty spot

shots.line: The striker runs up.
shots.scene: Wide: grey STRIKER runs up to the ball; HERO in goal (gold gloves) in ready stance

shots.line: To everyone else, it's a guess.
shots.scene: Goal diagram from behind the striker: question marks over both corners

shots.line: To you, it's a rerun.
shots.scene: HERO's view: the cyan ghost striker already shooting; REPLAY badge

shots.line: You already watched the ball go bottom left.
shots.scene: Ghost ball curves into the bottom-left corner, dotted path, callout BOTTOM LEFT

shots.line: You dive bottom left.
shots.scene: FREEZE: HERO mid-dive bottom left, gloves on the real ball, frozen grass bits

shots.line: Every.
shots.scene: Another save, other angle, stamp check

shots.line: Single.
shots.scene: Another save, top angle

shots.line: Time.
shots.scene: HERO stands in goal with the ball under his arm, STRIKER on his knees

shots.line: But living ten seconds ahead has a price.
shots.scene: Dusk park bench: HERO alone, pensive, cyan shimmer flickers around him

shots.line: Every joke reaches you twice.
shots.scene: Lunch table: a friend (grey, cap) tells a joke; the line arrives twice: cyan bubble then real bubble

shots.line: First the punchline, then the setup.
shots.scene: Two cards in the wrong order: 1 PUNCHLINE, 2 SETUP

shots.line: You laugh at the wrong moment,
shots.scene: HERO bursts out laughing while everyone else is silent

shots.line: and people stop telling you jokes.
shots.scene: The friends turn away; the joker zips his lips; HERO's laugh fades

shots.line: Conversations feel like reruns.
shots.scene: Conversation: friend's mouth moves while his cyan ghost already finished; REPLAY icon; HERO bored

shots.line: You answer questions nobody has asked yet,
shots.scene: HERO answers ('Friday!') before the friend has asked; friend frozen mid-word, confused

shots.line: and your friends start to find it creepy.
shots.scene: Two friends whisper and side-eye HERO; cooler light

shots.line: Surprise parties don't exist for you anymore.
shots.scene: Dark living room: lights snap on, friends jump 'SURPRISE!' with confetti; HERO already facing them, deadpan

shots.line: And your brain is running two movies at the same time.
shots.scene: Diagram: head silhouette with two film strips feeding the brain, warm REAL and cyan +10 s; overload sparks

shots.line: By evening, the headaches are so bad that you sit in a dark room
shots.scene: Dark bedroom with blinds at evening: HERO on the bed edge, holding his head, cyan flickers pulse

shots.line: with your eyes closed,
shots.scene: bigFace HERO, eyes shut, in pain, almost dark

shots.line: just to make one of the worlds go away.
shots.scene: The cyan copy of the room fades away; HERO exhales

shots.line: Then comes the part nobody warns you about.
shots.scene: Restaurant establishing: warm pendant lamps, HERO and MIA at a table

shots.line: At a restaurant, you see a waiter across the room trip,
shots.scene: Across the room: the cyan ghost WAITER trips with his tray; the real one walks normally; HERO's eyes widen

shots.line: and a tray of glasses shatter.
shots.scene: Insert: cyan ghost glasses shatter on the floor; the real tray still intact

shots.line: You stand up.
shots.scene: HERO stands up fast, the chair skids back

shots.line: You start to move.
shots.scene: HERO starts to run between tables toward the waiter

shots.line: Ten seconds is long enough to see it.
shots.scene: FREEZE (cool tint): HERO mid-stride, waiter far away; timeline graphic 10 s: SEE IT check

shots.line: It isn't always long enough to stop it.
shots.scene: Same freeze: STOP IT gets a red cross; the distance is too big

shots.line: The glasses break.
shots.scene: Real: waiter trips, tray flips, glasses shatter; HERO reaches out too late; shake

shots.line: Exactly the way you saw them break.
shots.scene: Insert: real shards on the floor land exactly on the cyan ghost shards

shots.line: And from that day on,
shots.scene: Night city: HERO at a window/rooftop edge looking down at the street

shots.line: every accident you see in the blue world feels like a question.
shots.scene: Night street: cyan ghost accidents around HERO (a swerving car, a falling flowerpot, a scooter tumble) with question marks

shots.line: Are you fast enough?
shots.scene: bigFace HERO, worried and determined; cyan reflections; heartbeat

shots.line: Friday, four twelve p.m.
shots.scene: 3D: the intersection at golden afternoon, traffic light, slow crane down; HUD clock FRIDAY 4:12 PM

shots.line: You and Mia are walking home.
shots.scene: Medium tracking: HERO and MIA walk home side by side

shots.line: She has her earbuds in.
shots.scene: Insert: MIA's head with white earbuds, music notes

shots.line: She's looking at her phone.
shots.scene: MIA walks ahead, eyes on her phone

shots.line: She steps toward the crosswalk.
shots.scene: Low angle: MIA's feet step off the curb onto the crosswalk stripes; walk signal green

shots.line: And in the blue world, ten seconds ahead,
shots.scene: bigFace HERO lit cyan, eyes widen; HUD +10 s

shots.line: you see a truck run the red light.
shots.scene: Blue world: cyan ghost TRUCK runs the red light into the crosswalk

shots.line: Ten.
shots.scene: Wide: MIA on the crosswalk, HERO far behind; count 10

shots.line: You shout her name.
shots.scene: bigFace HERO shouting, rings

shots.line: She can't hear you.
shots.scene: MIA with earbuds, oblivious; the shout rings bounce off

shots.line: Nine. Eight.
shots.scene: Ghost truck closer in cyan, the real road still empty; counts 9, 8

shots.line: You're thirty meters behind her.
shots.scene: Wide side: dimension line 30 m between HERO and MIA

shots.line: You run.
shots.scene: HERO sprints, speed lines

shots.line: Seven.
shots.scene: Low angle running feet; count 7

shots.line: And the blue world changes.
shots.scene: The blue world glitches and re-renders; HUD RECALCULATING

shots.line: Because you moved, the future moved too.
shots.scene: Top-down street map: HERO dot moves, the predicted truck path and impact zone shift

shots.line: Now the truck isn't just heading for Mia.
shots.scene: Cyan ghost truck heading at ghost MIA

shots.line: It's heading for both of you.
shots.scene: Cyan ghost: both HERO and MIA inside the red impact circle

shots.line: Six. Five.
shots.scene: Real truck appears at the far end, headlights, red light; counts 6, 5

shots.line: For the first time, your power isn't telling you what will happen.
shots.scene: bigFace HERO running, intense; cyan flicker

shots.line: It's asking you what you're willing to do.
shots.scene: Slow motion: HERO mid-stride toward MIA, background blurred, heartbeat

shots.line: Four. Three.
shots.scene: Real truck big, horn, headlights; MIA still on her phone; counts 4, 3

shots.line: You don't stop.
shots.scene: HERO's determined face, running

shots.line: Two.
shots.scene: Low angle: the truck grille closing in; count 2

shots.line: You grab her backpack and pull.
shots.scene: Insert: HERO's hand grabs MIA's backpack strap and yanks

shots.line: You both fall hard onto the sidewalk.
shots.scene: Both fall backward hard onto the sidewalk; impact shake

shots.line: One.
shots.scene: Ground level at the crosswalk: the truck's shadow sweeps in; count 1

shots.line: The truck roars through the space where she was standing.
shots.scene: The truck roars through the dotted outline where MIA was standing

shots.line: Zero.
shots.scene: Silence: HUD T-0, dust settles; the cyan and real worlds line up; HERO and MIA on the sidewalk

shots.line: Mia stares at you, shaking.
shots.scene: MIA sitting on the sidewalk, trembling, staring at HERO

shots.line: "How did you know?"
shots.scene: bigFace MIA: 'How did you know?' scared

shots.line: And for once, you tell her the truth.
shots.scene: Two-shot: HERO beside her, turns to her, warm light

shots.line: "I didn't know.
shots.scene: bigFace HERO: 'I didn't know.'

shots.line: I saw."
shots.scene: bigFace HERO: 'I saw.' eyes glow cyan softly

shots.line: So, is any of this real?
shots.scene: Blueprint: IS ANY OF THIS REAL?

shots.line: Not the blue world.
shots.scene: Blueprint: cyan ghost figure gets a red cross: NOT THE BLUE WORLD

shots.line: But part of it is happening inside your head right now.
shots.scene: Blueprint: head profile, the brain pulses

shots.line: Your brain is always about a tenth of a second behind reality.
shots.scene: Blueprint: two timelines REALITY and YOUR BRAIN offset by 0.1 s

shots.line: That's how long it takes to process what your eyes see.
shots.scene: Blueprint: eye to brain signal travelling: PROCESSING

shots.line: To hide that delay,
shots.scene: Blueprint: moving ball, the real ball lags

shots.line: your brain quietly predicts where moving things are about to be.
shots.scene: Blueprint: the brain draws a predicted ball ahead of the real one

shots.line: A fastball reaches the batter in about four tenths of a second.
shots.scene: Night ballpark: grey pitcher throws to HERO at bat; 0.4 s readout

shots.line: Batters don't swing at where the ball is.
shots.scene: Blueprint side view: the ball's real position vs where the bat goes

shots.line: They swing at where their brain predicts it will be.
shots.scene: Blueprint: the bat meets the predicted ball

shots.line: So in a tiny way, you already live a little bit in the future.
shots.scene: Blueprint: line figure with a tiny cyan ghost 0.1 s ahead

shots.line: You'd just be living there a hundred times further ahead.
shots.scene: Blueprint: the ghost slides to +10 s; x100

shots.line: That night, you lie in bed and close your eyes.
shots.scene: Night bedroom, moonlight through blinds: HERO lies in bed and closes his eyes

shots.line: And for the first time in your life, the blue world shows you...
shots.scene: bigFace HERO eyes closed; the cyan glow around him dims; HUD flickers

shots.line: nothing.
shots.scene: The cyan copy vanishes; HUD +10 s: blank

shots.line: The next ten seconds are completely black.
shots.scene: Everything fades to black; only the HUD T-10 dimly, then gone

shots.line: What would YOU do with ten seconds of the future? Tell us in the comments.
shots.scene: End screen: What would YOU do? + subscribe + cast line-up
